details:
On SDK 3.6.1, when a script changes `JsonConvert.DefaultSettings`, specifically by adding `JsonSerializerSettings.TypeNameHandling = TypeNameHandling.Auto`, SDK uploads fail as a list is serialized for tags and is expected to be parsed as an array.

The SDK should explicitly pass JsonSerializerSettings to json (de)serialization methods to address this.
